title: Contact page one-character text tweak to trigger rebuild

requirements.summary: Add exactly one visible period character to existing Contact page text without changing layout, styling, routing, or functionality.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx` contains exactly one additional `.` character compared to the current version (e.g., add a trailing period to an existing sentence).
No other functional changes are introduced (no new components, routes, links, or logic changes).
The app builds successfully after the change.

file_operations.description: Make a one-character-only change by adding a single `.` to an existing visible text string (e.g., add a trailing period to an existing sentence) while leaving all layout, styling, routing, imports, and functionality unchanged.
